records.scope: Flask application implementing the parkers.co.uk mirror: the expert review pages (headline, verdict likes/dislikes, five rated sections, rivals, gallery), the free valuation flow (make → model → purpose → year plate → CAP derivative → private/dealer/part-ex/trade ranges), the registration-number valuation lookup, the cars-for-sale search with filters (make, body, fuel, transmission, budget, monthly price) and sorts, listing detail pages, the news section, the best-cars guides, owner reviews with the write-a-review form, insurance-group pages, the car tax guide, site search, and the account domain (sign in, shortlist, saved valuations). Route and URL shapes follow the live site (/{make}/{model}/, /{make}/{model}/{gen}/, /{make}/{model}/{gen}/used-prices/, /valuation/{make}/{model}/{gen}/{purpose}/{year}/{derivative}/, /cars-for-sale/search/, /news/, /best-cars/, /{make}/{model}/{gen}/owner-reviews/, /insurance/…, /car-tax/…, /search/).

Deterministic seeder (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, BENCHMARK_TODAY=2026-09-24). All content rows are loaded from the captured upstream snapshots in scraped_data/ (gitignored; the built seed ships as instance_seed/parkers.db in the asset archive). Valuation grids are anchored on ranges captured from the live site's own valuation pages/API and extended with the documented depreciation curve; benchmark users share one frozen bcrypt digest so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible.

Frozen snapshot of the live site's expert review pages (https://www.parkers.co.uk/{make}/{model}/) as served on 2026-09-24: per model the schema.org JSON-LD review blob (headline, star rating, pros/cons, section prose and sub-ratings, verdict-box ratings), the hero image URL, gallery thumbnail URLs and the rival-model panels. Captured via the live site's own server-rendered HTML. The Smart #1 / #3 review records are captured from the live site's /smart/1/ and /smart/3/ review pages (upstream URL slugs, no '#' fragment).

Per-generation spec tables captured from the live site's /{make}/{model}/{gen}/specifications/ pages: every derivative's price when new, engine, fuel, transmission, MPG, insurance group, boot space and dimensions, matched to the CAP derivative taxonomy via the live site's own taxonomy-search API display names. Includes the Mazda CX-5 SUV (2017 - 2026) and Smart #1 / #3 spec generations captured from the same live pages.

The cars-for-sale inventory (1,161 cards) captured from the live site's own search result pages (parkers.co.uk/cars-for-sale/): each card's title, derivative text, price, monthly price, mileage, year plate, transmission, fuel, body, seller badge and real listing image URL.
News articles captured from the live site's /news/ section on 2026-09-24: title, standfirst, hero image URL, publication date and the full article body as served.

Best-cars guides captured from the live site's /best-cars/ pages: title, guide body copy and the ranked recommendation lists as published (headers and non-car entries filtered by clean_guide_ranked in seed_data.py).

Owner-review content captured from the live site's /{make}/{model}/{gen}/owner-reviews/ pages and per-review pages: owner totals, average owner rating, star distribution and the individual owner reviews (author, rating, publication date, year/plate, bought-from and the full 'in their own words' review text), for the 16 generations the live site had owner reviews for.
Insurance-group rows captured from the live site's insurance pages for the shipped derivatives (1,327 rows).

Valuation anchors captured from the live site's own used-prices pages and taxonomy-search API responses: the year-plate lists per generation and the CAP derivative groupings, plus the price ranges captured from the live valuation pages (e.g. Fiesta Zetec 1.0T EcoBoost 100PS 3d 2019/19: private £3,210-£4,250, dealer £4,520-£4,790, part-ex £3,470-£3,800).
Make logo URLs captured from the live site's own header/footer and make index pages (parkers-images.bauersecure.com logo renditions).
Upstream URL → local path mapping for every downloaded image; feeds the per-file source_url column of asset_inventory.json.

Per-file inventory (bytes, SHA-256, upstream source URL) for every managed image under static/images/ (2,394 real parkers-images.bauersecure.com renditions; zero placeholders); enforced by the image build's check_asset_inventory.py gate.

Frozen SQLite seed built deterministically from the captured snapshots (PYTHONHASHSEED=0): 37 makes, 169 models, 205 generations, 1,079 derivatives, 10,517 valuation rows, 1,161 listings, 104 news articles, 30 guides, 126 owner reviews (full text + author/date/year-plate/bought metadata) + 14 owner stat rows, 12 registration lookups, insurance groups and the 2026/27 tax rates, benchmark user accounts.

2,394 real images downloaded from the live site's own image CDN (parkers-images.bauersecure.com): 130 make logos, 169 review heroes plus ~700 gallery frames, ~1,100 cars-for-sale listing photos and ~250 news/guide heroes. No placeholder or synthetic imagery; every file's source URL is recorded in asset_inventory.json.

Jinja2 templates rendering the parkers.co.uk mirror pages (upstream URL shapes and page structure for reviews, specs, valuations, cars-for-sale, news, guides, insurance, tax, owner reviews and the account area). Layout and copy follow the 2026-09-24 upstream capture; template chrome (nav, footer) reproduces the upstream site navigation labels and section names.
Site stylesheet reproducing the upstream parkers.co.uk look (fonts, colours, card grid, review star styling) for the benchmark mirror.
Small vanilla-JS enhancements (gallery lightbox, valuation form chaining) mirroring upstream interactive behaviour; no external network calls.

Deterministic pytest suite for the mirror (23 tests): health probe, core pages, review/spec/valuation chains, cars-for-sale filters, scored search, news/guides, insurance/tax, owner reviews, auth+shortlist, saved valuations, registration/profile, seed idempotence shape. Runs against a scratch copy of the shipped seed.

20 benchmark tasks (Parkers--0..--19) over the mirror: free valuations and part-exchange numbers, specs comparisons, insurance-group lookups, review reading, cars-for-sale filtering and shortlist management, owner-review reading and submission, news and best-cars guides, car-tax rates, search. Each row: web_name, id, ques, web (http://localhost:40087/), upstream_url.
Pinned Flask extension dependencies for the mirror app (Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, Flask-Login, Flask-WTF, Flask-Bcrypt).
Provenance and scope notice for the parkers.co.uk benchmark mirror: what is mirrored, the benchmark-fixture user accounts, and the 2026-09-24 capture source.
Per-site health probe called by the control plane via /_health; reports live DB counts (makes, models, generations, derivatives, valuations, listings, news, guides, owner reviews).
This manifest: per-artifact provenance classification for every tracked file group in the parkers site directory.
Reserved icon directory (currently only .gitkeep placeholder); mirror ships no favicon or icon assets beyond the managed imagery.
Zero-byte .gitkeep placeholders keeping the empty static/css, static/js, static/icons and static/external_cache directories present in git.
